question: For what purpose may cakes mixed with ghee be offered into the fire?
premises: apūpair ājyayuktair specifies cakes joined with ghee
mantrasiddhaye states the purpose as mantra accomplishment
inference: One may offer cakes mixed with ghee for the accomplishment of the mantra.
plain_english: One should offer cakes mixed with ghee, for the accomplishment of the mantra.
